description: Privacy scan mutation test: adding any forbidden field to view model types MUST fail the scan

mutation_test_forbidden_fields_in_protec.method: For each forbidden substring, construct a JSON object with ProtectionView fields plus an injected field named after the forbidden substring. Run scan_value and assert the forbidden field is flagged.

mutation_test_forbidden_fields_in_readin.method: Same as above, using a JSON object shaped like ReadinessView.

populated_presenter_model_carries_no_bio.method: Construct a fully populated PresenterModel (all nested views set) and assert forbidden_fields returns empty.
populated_presenter_model_carries_no_bio.fields_checked_recursively: all nested view types including ReadinessView, ProtectionView, EnrollmentView, ReviewView, PendingMerge, PendingReplace, PendingPamToggle, ErrorView, ProfileRowView, PamServiceRowView, QualityView

presenter_model_carries_no_biometrics.method: Default PresenterModel (all fields None/empty) must pass scan.

scan_mechanism: Serialize struct to serde_json::Value, recursively walk all object keys, flag any key whose lowercase form contains a forbidden substring.
scan_value_exposed: privacy::scan_value() made public so mutation tests can inject forbidden field names directly into JSON without defining new Serialize structs.
